# Leaflet 1.9.4 (vendored)

[Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com/) by Volodymyr Agafonkin and contributors,
BSD 2-Clause License (see `LICENSE`). Copied unchanged from the npm package
`leaflet@1.9.4` (`dist/leaflet.js`, `dist/leaflet.css`, `dist/images/`), which
was verified against the registry checksum
`sha1 23fae724e282fa25745aff82ca4d394748db7d8d`.

It is vendored so the planner page loads no third-party scripts. Map tiles
come from OpenStreetMap and are attributed on the map.
